qs.q: Which cellular process is impaired in patients with chronic granulomatous disease?
qs.e: Chronic granulomatous disease results from defects in NADPH oxidase, which is required for the respiratory burst that generates superoxide (O2•−) in leukocytes. This impairs their ability to kill phagocytosed microbes, leading to recurrent infections. ## SECTION 5: OTHER MECHANISMS OF CELL DEATH
